newsitem.title: INDIA: CCCL worth 500 mln rupees - India's Shaw.
newsitem.headline: CCCL worth 500 mln rupees - India's Shaw.

text.p: Indian liquor maker Shaw Wallace and Company Ltd said on Monday that it expects to raise about 500 million rupees from the sale of cosmetics division Calcutta Chemicals Company Ltd (CCCL).
The Calcutta-based firm said in a statement that it planned to sell CCCL as it was not part of its core business of liquor and beer.

"Shaw Wallace is likely to raise nearly 500 million rupees from the sale of the consumer products division which owns well known brands such as Margo body soap, New Neem Toothpaste and Aramusk," the statement said.
